subject: Re: include file for all of fwd mode?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: include file for all of fwd mode?
parts:
[moving to stan-dev]

Great news.

But I'm afraid there's no more global header for just fvar.

I believe the plan's just to put everything in math.hpp.
The plan was to build out from the minimal things we knew
we'd need, one of which is everything in one include.

Until someone needs just forward mode, I don't think it's
worth trying to create an include that'll work with math
and fwd and nothing else.

It should be OK to have hierarchical includes, though.
I just want to make sure all those hierarchical includes
are sensible. I believe we have ones now that won't work
because of broken include orders derived from generating
the .hpp files programatically.

- Bob

> On Jun 24, 2015, at 4:31 PM, Rob Trangucci <robert.t...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Hey Bob,
>
> I merged my branch with develop with the hopes of putting in a PR today, but I can't seem to find the master include header for all of fvar. Does that exist anymore? If not I'll just do everything piecemeal but I'd like to avoid this if possible.
>
> Rob
